mapper.select: SELECT id,schedule_id,task_id,trigger_type,scheduled_time,business_date,status,attempt_no,execution_id,backfill_batch_id,parameter_values,message,created_by,create_time,update_time FROM sql_task_schedule_run WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_schedule_run WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_execution WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED','RUNNING','CANCELLING')
mapper.update: UPDATE sql_task_schedule_run r JOIN sql_task_execution e ON e.id=r.execution_id SET r.status=CASE WHEN e.status='SUCCEEDED' THEN 'SUCCEEDED' WHEN e.status='FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN e.status='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE r.status END,r.message=CASE WHEN e.status='FAILED' THEN e.error_message WHEN e.status='CANCELLED' THEN '执行已取消' ELSE r.message END,r.update_time=NOW() WHERE r.status='SUBMITTED' AND e.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')

UPDATE sql_task_schedule s JOIN sql_task_schedule_run r ON r.schedule_id=s.id LEFT JOIN sql_task_schedule_run newer ON newer.schedule_id=s.id AND newer.id>r.id SET s.last_run_status=r.status,s.update_time=NOW() WHERE newer.id IS NULL AND (s.last_run_status IS NULL OR s.last_run_status<>r.status)
UPDATE sql_task_schedule_run SET status='FAILED',message='重试认领超时，等待重新提交',update_time=NOW() WHERE status='RETRYING' AND update_time<=#{before}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.schedule_id,r.task_id,r.trigger_type,r.scheduled_time,r.business_date,r.status,r.attempt_no,r.execution_id,r.backfill_batch_id,r.parameter_values,r.message,r.created_by,r.create_time,r.update_time FROM sql_task_schedule_run r JOIN sql_task_schedule s ON s.id=r.schedule_id WHERE r.status='FAILED' AND r.attempt_no<=s.max_retries AND r.update_time<=DATE_SUB(#{now},INTERVAL s.retry_interval_seconds SECOND) ORDER BY r.update_time LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sql_task_schedule_run SET status='RETRYING',update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
UPDATE sql_task_schedule_run SET status='RETRIED',message='已创建下一次重试',update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RETRYING'
